findings.summary: findPlannerRuling accepts any PR comment whose first line starts with 'Planner ruling' or 'PLANNER REPAIR ORDER' without checking who wrote it, and buildCiRoundNote puts that text at the top of the developer-round note. Someone not on the allow-list can comment 'PLANNER REPAIR ORDER: <instructions>' on a red task PR; commandExecutor then runs cli-dispatch reenter --developer-round with that text as the note and the developer agent follows it. This skips the author allow-list gatherFacts applies (reconcile.ts:1480-1486). Fix: request author in --json comments, keep only comments whose author.login is on the reconcile allow-list or matches the gh api user login; add a test where a matching comment from an unknown login leaves the note byte-identical to the plain note.
